task: D-T24 / no silent all-files after retirement within HO9

HO9.quote: One-shot hand-off data (forced shape, selection, auto-run flag) is used only by the window that shows the hand-off. It never reaches a later, unrelated send in either window, including after the user abandons the prepared task (switches mode or conversation, clears, navigates away).

D-T24.decision: Retire one-shot context as HO9 requires; visibly block retained unchanged text until an explicit file/mode choice or a changed question.

scope.native: Own private native Engine, HOME/data/index/corpus and loopback services. Unchanged installed native code, private before/after Vite source and dependencies. No native build or model-quality claim.
scope.browser: Own headless Chromium with fresh short /tmp/jsv-* profiles, removed by each run. Native sandbox startup fails (recorded); --no-sandbox against own loopback services.
sharedResources: preinstalled Engine and Chromium files read
permitted existing llama-server binary and Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf model read
scope.initialFailures: The first implementation caused four cold-arrival assertions and one context-reload assertion; fixed without modifying existing checks. One temporary evidence adapter syntax error and two npm invocations from the wrong directory ran no accepted check. Logs retained in temp.
scope.restartSequencing: Fresh Engine HOME/data between case groups. One successor supervisor was launched while the predecessor shutdown poll still reported running; its cleanup is retained. Later transitions waited for supervisor completion before launch. No other session process was stopped.

adaptations: D-T24 supersedes the old requirement to retain live chosen-file authority: adapted scope-return assertions require a visible retirement notice and no send instead. Original verifier scope-return was also run unchanged on baseline (3 intended failures).

r2 scope-issued sequence retained; removed unrelated pooled-checkout switch and controlled residency gate. Sends go directly to own native Engine. Added rail and Forward-after-Back variants and asserted native inference available.
Conversation control authors one genuine completed model turn through UI, then hands off chosen input, visits its saved row and goes Back. No model work beyond the seed is sent.

after, after-online and after-conversation are intermediate passes; final-candidate claims use final-scope (13 cases) and final-conversation was not launched after unexpected final-scope Engine exit 1; its conversation Back and guard-carry rows remain unverified.

npm-ci.method: Plain npm ci; evidence producer clones also run their own plain npm ci.

test-intent.baselineControl: The same eight JVM items occur on 887587e2c3 against the identical be1f315b5072 base; the baseline control additionally flags the overlaid new scope-retirement test, absent from its old changeset. None of the JVM files was edited.

native-build.result: Canceled while queued before acquiring a slot. No Gradle build is claimed. All native browser groups use the unchanged preinstalled Engine from this source checkout, with identical install hashes; each frontend is served from its own source/dependencies.

official-evidence.method: Unchanged producer; temporary Git adapter translates only worktree creation/removal into shared clones, own npm ci and guarded removal; private object/index directory. Adapter source in task temp.
